title: Weak continuity of pulled-back n-forms under uniform convergence with bounded Lipschitz constants (parent B4 lemma)
statement: For n, N' ∈ ℕ, L ∈ ℝ≥0, L-Lipschitz maps H_j, H : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{N'} (j ∈ ℕ) with H_j → H uniformly on ℝⁿ, a Lebesgue integrable w : ℝⁿ → ℝ and a continuous, compactly supported n-form ω on ℝ^{N'}: ∫ w(u)·ω(H_j(u))(DH_j(u)e_1, …, DH_j(u)e_n) du → ∫ w(u)·ω(H(u))(DH(u)e_1, …, DH(u)e_n) du as j → ∞, where DK(u) = fderiv ℝ K u and e_a = EuclideanSpace.single a 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N' : ℕ) (L : NNReal) (Hs : ℕ → Euclid n → Euclid N') (H : Euclid n → Euclid N') (w : Euclid n → ℝ) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') n), (∀ j, LipschitzWith L (Hs j)) → LipschitzWith L H → TendstoUniformly Hs H atTop → Integrable w → Continuous ω → HasCompactSupport ω → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ u, w u * ω (Hs j u) (fun a => fderiv ℝ (Hs j) u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))) atTop (𝓝 (∫ u, w u * ω (H u) (fun a => fderiv ℝ H u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))))
